SELECT pa.id, pa.application_no AS applicationNo, pa.title, pa.applicant_id AS applicantId, COALESCE(u1.display_name, u1.username) AS applicantName, pa.approver_id AS approverId, COALESCE(u2.display_name, u2.username) AS approverName, pa.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, pa.application_type AS applicationType, pa.purpose, pa.total_amount AS totalAmount, pa.currency, pa.required_date AS requiredDate, pa.status, pa.approval_comment AS approvalComment, pa.submitted_at AS submittedAt, pa.created_at AS createdAt FROM procurement_application pa LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON u1.id = pa.applicant_id AND u1.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON u2.id = pa.approver_id AND u2.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = pa.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
pa.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (pa.application_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pa.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND pa.status = #{statusCode}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement_application_supplier pas WHERE pas.application_id = pa.id AND pas.is_selected = 1 AND pas.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement_application_supplier pas WHERE pas.application_id = pa.id AND pas.is_selected = 1 AND pas.deleted_at IS NULL)
ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC
